section_summary: This section contains U.S. Political Adviser Despatch No. 987 from Tokyo, dated April 19, 1947, forwarding five copies of a reference brochure entitled 'Conversion Tables' prepared by the Civil Property Custodian of GHQ SCAP. The brochure provides official mathematical equivalents, conversion tables, and explanatory notes bridging traditional Japanese units of measurement, the metric system, and United States customary units. Topics covered include measurements of length, area, capacity, volume, weight, textiles, lumber, foodstuffs, dollar-yen currency conversion, and a concordance of Japanese imperial eras with Western calendar years.

subfiles.about: Transmittal of five copies of a reference brochure of conversion tables between Japanese and United States units of measurement.
subfiles.summary: Transmits copies of GHQ SCAP's brochure converting Japanese measurement units to United States units for Department use.
subfiles.title: Tables of Conversion from Japanese Units of Measure to United States Units

subfiles.about: A reference handbook providing mathematical equivalents and conversion tables between Japanese traditional units, metric units, and United States customary units.
subfiles.from: Civil Property Custodian, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.summary: This reference handbook prepared by the Civil Property Custodian of GHQ SCAP provides conversion formulas, mathematical definitions, and detailed tables comparing Japanese traditional units, metric units, and United States customary units. It covers measurements of length, area, capacity, volume, weight, textiles, room sizes, lumber, and foodstuffs, as well as official exchange rates between United States dollars and Japanese yen. The brochure also includes an explanatory guide and conversion table correlating Japanese imperial calendar eras from Emperor Jimmu through Showa 24 with Western calendar years.
subfiles.title: Conversion Tables
